# Third-party sprite sources

The following Minecraft fan renders are stored locally under this folder. MCRender states that its renders may be used for school projects and other non-commercial creator work; credit is appreciated but not required. The renders are not official Mojang/Microsoft assets, and must not be sold as standalone assets or presented as official.

| Local file | Original source page | Direct image URL | Attribution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `mcrender-iron-golem.png` | [Iron Golem PNG — MCRender](https://www.mcrender.net/png/iron-golem) | [PNG file](https://ifzp2hwuc5.ufs.sh/f/RFyaFWbnYvRpHylGHG4r7WZnIMwCtjTR4igFv8N3bSh1Pa9k) | Suggested: “Iron Golem render: [MCRender](https://www.mcrender.net/png/iron-golem)” |

All five images were downloaded from the image URLs embedded by their source pages. Their PNG format, dimensions, alpha channels, and transparent pixels were checked locally. These character and mob renders are retained as unused files; the current Home page uses only the supplied small inventory-item PNGs. The original supplied sprite files were not overwritten.
